author: Forbes
description:
Our tech editor got her hands on Apple’s latest budget-friendly phone, which features small yet powerful upgrades.

The iPhone 17e's most important feature—aside from its new colorway 🌸—is MagSafe charging. You can also expect new camera software and more storage options. As one of Apple’s more affordable iPhone options, it starts at $599. You can preorder now, and it begins shipping March 11.

For a deep dive into the phone's latest features—plus a breakdown of Apple's newest devices, including the MacBook Neo—visit the link in our bio.
